# Weekly roll-up ruling (e2e agentic synthetic)

Tanya (team owner) ruled on how the week's reactions reach people:

> the per-run bundle stays, and on Fridays we add one roll-up of the week —
> what moved, what is still open — instead of asking anyone to scroll back

Tina asked whether the roll-up replaces the per-run bundle. Tanya held that it
does not: the bundle is for the run, the roll-up is for the week. Rejected: a
daily digest, because most days carry a single run and it would repeat the
bundle word for word.

positions.name: WeeklyRollupVsRunBundle
positions.frame: What does each recurring update artifact answer for, and does a weekly roll-up replace the per-run bundle or sit beside it so the week's reactions reach people without scrolling back?
positions.why: All five segments turn on one question: how weekly reactions reach people when a per-run bundle already exists. src-1 frames the ruling and src-3 records the question it answered. src-2 states the ruling, which keeps the per-run bundle and adds a Friday roll-up. src-4 gives the reason the two are not substitutes: the bundle serves the run and the roll-up serves the week. src-5 rejects a daily digest because it would repeat the bundle. src-4 is reported through the memo author with split footing, and src-1 reports the ruling in the memo's own voice. The set holds a settled directive (src-2) alongside a reasoned argument (src-4) without resolving the tension between them.

placements.why: The position's members turn on how the week's reactions reach people without anyone scrolling back. That echoes the leaf's claim that decisions made in chat disappear into scroll-back. The support is thematic but indirect: the position concerns update format and cadence, not decision capture itself. Reused rather than minted because no new subject is named that future envelopes would keep feeding.

mints.name: UpdateCadence
mints.frame: Which recurring update artifact carries which span of work, and what cadence and channel get the week's changes to people?
mints.title: Recurring update artifacts and their cadence
mints.why: No existing stratum holds the grouping, and the position concerns the cadence and kind of recurring update artifact (per-run bundle versus weekly roll-up). That is the categorical kind of thinking the ChangeCommunications coordinate names: cadence, channels, and artifacts.

connections.why: The position's members decide what each recurring update artifact answers for and how often it runs, which is the cadence-and-artifact grouping the stratum holds.

unconnected.why: Its theme is decision loss to chat scroll-back, not update cadence. The only stratum minted here covers cadence, and no existing stratum holds decision loss, so it stays unconnected for now.
